headline: BR Partners Calls Post-Election Selloff Heavy-Handed, Urges Fiscal Plan
summary: BR Partners executive Ricardo Lacerda stated that market participants overreacted in the post-election selloff, emphasizing that the Lula administration must provide a clear fiscal plan to restore confidence.
why: Financial sentiment in Brazil remains sensitive to government fiscal commitments, driving movements in the Ibovespa and sovereign bond spreads.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Brazilian stocks slumped following the election, prompting calls for clear fiscal targets.
